args.summary: Fixed the bug in `separability_matrix` for nested CompoundModels. The issue was in the `_cstack` function at line 245 of `/testbed/astropy/modeling/separable.py`. Changed `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1` to `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = right`.
